mechanism: Pair same-height upper and lower tangent endpoints in red/blue, inviting counting the two common exterior tangents and overlooking the two other valid joins to the unmarked near-right apex.
primary_unique_math_proof: Of nine vertex pairs, all three from 0L cross the left interior. The two far cross pairs 0U-1D and 0D-1U cross the right interior. The four surviving joins are 0U-1U,0D-1D,0U-1L,0D-1L. Thus exactly4 remain. Four point markers lie on existing vertices, add no line, and do not change either triangle or the single-join task.
primary_human_clarity_assessment: Four small legal colored dots at existing upper and lower vertices; all original solid contours and both unmarked apex vertices stay visible. No invalid candidate connector is inserted into the source diagram.
